machine: Linux cloud execution workspace, Intel Xeon Platinum8573C; other task processes also active
method: Fully evaluate each advanceGame1 and measure process CPU time. Each sample advances1200 ticks from the same actual saved checkpoint. Early=cut6h; late=cut36h. Includes automatic-policy command work. These are CPU timings, not end-to-end UI or network latency.

profile.instrumentation_caveat: Profiling changes runtime cost; its timings are not compared with the uninstrumented benchmark
profile.cause: validateSpatial calls validatePlacement for each placement; each placement rebuilds other placements geometry/occupancy. Tile Map/Set comparisons repeatedly allocate Integer row-major products/sums.

optimization: For coordinates all within0..511, compare (y,x) without allocating row-major indices; preserve exact old (tileIndex,x,y) fallback for every invalid coordinate. No validation, schema, history or simulation rule removed.
limits: Two finite samples, not a worst-case real-time proof
Before optimization,2/1200 late-sample ticks exceeded50ms; after optimization none did in these samples
Full spatial validation still rebuilds occupancy quadratically; that broader refactor remains separate
Cumulative allocation remains substantial even though measured retained state stays small; no speculative history compaction was added
